method: For every gold CONDITION/CONSEQUENCE pair, both human-gold boxes and both independently generated neural-parser boxes must contain the same MULTISET of sense-labelled concepts for exact sense consistency; separately compare concept lemma only, and operator presence. Same standard on separate test and dev splits, original input hashes checked.

limitations: Exact scoped lemmas and senses are NECESSARY but not SUFFICIENT for sound formal derivation: the clause graph, operator variable links, referents and quantifiers may still be wrong.
Gold DRS semantic annotations are expert linguistic interpretations, not scientific reality; this is NOT formal automated proof of genuine novel empirical facts.
This study does not test cross-document identity or dream and quote-world projection.
PMB dev/test source semantic gold was published with the neural parser original outputs; cannot guarantee complete absence of training/test exposure beyond authors release protocol.
This comparison follows a previous operator benchmark on the same data; it is a stricter diagnostic, not a new heldout model evaluation.
